newsitem.title: UK: Union at U.K. bank calls strike ballot Monday.
newsitem.headline: Union at U.K. bank calls strike ballot Monday.

text.p: Barclays Plc staff will be asked to cast their vote in a strike action ballot which will commence on Monday, said UNiFI, tbe finance union for the High Street bank on Friday.

The ballot to be conducted by the unions UNiFI and BIFU, will ask members if they are prepared to take industrial action including strikes and further disruptive action against the bank. Together the two unions represent more than three quarters of all Barclays staff.

The union said the dispute has been building for some time after Barclays' announced it planned to impose a new pay and grading structure which will result in a pay and pensions freeze for most staff.
It will also involve a 2.5 percent cut in the existing package from 1998 onwards, said the union. UNiFI has 46,000 members representing some two thirds of Barclays staff.
